description: Device firmware mapping configuration (M1-E, extended in M1-F). Each family maps the PCI/USB module aliases of its kernel modules to one Debian non-free-firmware package. Input to tools/hwe/qualify-firmware-mappings.py; not read at runtime.

families.description: AMD/ATI graphics functions handled by the amdgpu or radeon kernel modules (matched by their kernel module aliases) -> Debian firmware-amd-graphics from non-free-firmware (ADR-0001). A proposal only; nothing is installed.
families.reason: Debian firmware-amd-graphics provides the binary firmware for AMD/ATI graphics chips supported by the amdgpu and radeon drivers.

families.description: Qualcomm Atheros USB Bluetooth controllers handled by the ath3k kernel module (matched by its kernel module aliases; the module declares firmware shipped only by firmware-atheros) -> Debian firmware-atheros from non-free-firmware (ADR-0001). A proposal only; nothing is installed.
families.reason: The ath3k Bluetooth driver requests firmware that Debian ships in firmware-atheros.

families.description: Qualcomm Atheros wireless devices on PCI or USB handled by the ar5523, ath10k_pci, ath6kl_usb or wil6210 kernel modules (matched by their kernel module aliases; their declared firmware is shipped only by firmware-atheros) -> Debian firmware-atheros from non-free-firmware (ADR-0001). SDIO devices (ath6kl_sdio) and modules without declared firmware (ath11k, ath12k) are not mapped. A proposal only; nothing is installed.
families.reason: The ar5523, ath10k, ath6kl and wil6210 drivers request firmware that Debian ships in firmware-atheros.

families.description: Broadcom BCM2033 USB Bluetooth controllers handled by the bcm203x kernel module (matched by its kernel module alias; the module declares firmware shipped only by bluez-firmware) -> Debian bluez-firmware from non-free-firmware (ADR-0001). A proposal only; nothing is installed.
families.reason: The bcm203x Bluetooth driver requests the BCM2033 firmware that Debian ships in bluez-firmware.

families.description: Broadcom/Cypress 802.11 devices handled by the brcmfmac kernel module on PCI or USB (matched by its kernel module aliases) -> Debian firmware-brcm80211 from non-free-firmware (ADR-0001). SDIO devices and brcmsmac (BCMA bus) are not representable in inventory v1 and are excluded. A proposal only; nothing is installed.
families.reason: Debian firmware-brcm80211 provides the binary firmware for Broadcom/Cypress 802.11 wireless devices supported by the brcmfmac driver.

families.description: Intel graphics functions handled by the i915 or xe kernel modules (matched by their kernel module aliases) -> Debian firmware-intel-graphics from non-free-firmware (ADR-0001). IPU/camera devices are not mapped. A proposal only; nothing is installed.
families.reason: Debian firmware-intel-graphics provides the binary firmware for Intel graphics supported by the i915 and xe drivers.

families.description: Intel wireless devices handled by the iwlwifi, iwl3945 or iwl4965 kernel modules (matched by their kernel module aliases) -> Debian firmware-iwlwifi from non-free-firmware (ADR-0001). A proposal only; nothing is installed.
families.reason: Debian firmware-iwlwifi provides the binary firmware for Intel wireless cards supported by the iwlwifi, iwl3945 and iwl4965 drivers.

families.description: MediaTek and Ralink wireless devices on PCI or USB handled by the mt76-family, mt7601u, rt2800pci/usb, rt61pci or rt73usb kernel modules (matched by their kernel module aliases; their declared firmware is shipped only by firmware-mediatek) -> Debian firmware-mediatek from non-free-firmware (ADR-0001). Bluetooth functions of combo cards are not mapped. A proposal only; nothing is installed.
families.reason: The MediaTek mt76/mt7601u and Ralink rt2x00 wireless drivers request firmware that Debian ships in firmware-mediatek.

families.description: Realtek wireless devices on PCI or USB handled by the rtlwifi, rtl8xxxu, rtw88 or rtw89 kernel modules (matched by their kernel module aliases; their declared firmware is shipped only by firmware-realtek) -> Debian firmware-realtek from non-free-firmware (ADR-0001). Realtek Ethernet, Bluetooth, audio and SDIO devices are not mapped. A proposal only; nothing is installed.
families.reason: The Realtek rtlwifi, rtl8xxxu, rtw88 and rtw89 wireless drivers request firmware that Debian ships in firmware-realtek.

excluded_modules.brcmsmac: Only bcma: aliases; the BCMA bus is not representable in inventory v1, and its BCMA cores are also claimed by b43 (firmware from contrib, not authorised). Deferred to a future inventory/schema and firmware-policy review.

excluded_aliases.pci:v000010ECd00008192sv*sd*bc*sc*i*: Also claimed by r8192e_pci (staging RTL8192E driver), whose declared firmware (RTL8192E/*.img) Debian does not ship; the modalias cannot tell RTL8192SE from RTL8192E, so rtl8192se's mapping excludes this ID.
excluded_aliases.usb:v050Dp7050d*dc*dsc*dp*ic*isc*ip*in*: Belkin ID also claimed by p54usb (declared firmware isl3887usb/isl3886usb not shipped by Debian) and rt2500usb (no firmware); the modalias cannot tell the chip, so rt73usb's mapping excludes this ID.

reviewed_shared_claims.radeon|radeonfb: radeonfb is the legacy framebuffer driver for the same Radeon chips; it declares and loads no firmware, so firmware-amd-graphics remains the only firmware package for these devices (reviewed in M1-E).

reviewed_foreign_requests.brcmfmac|brcm/brcmfmac43456-sdio.bin: Declared by brcmfmac but shipped by raspi-firmware: firmware for an SDIO-only Broadcom chip (Raspberry Pi boards). SDIO is not representable in inventory v1 and not mapped, so it does not affect the PCI/USB brcmfmac mapping (reviewed in M1-F).

deferred.brcmsmac: M1-E: only bcma: aliases (BCMA bus not representable in inventory v1); cores also claimed by b43 (contrib firmware).
deferred.r8169, r8152, r8153_ecm (Realtek Etherne: Firmware is loaded only for some chip revisions, which the modalias cannot distinguish (e.g. all RTL8168 variants share 10ec:8168); a per-device firmware requirement cannot be proven.
deferred.btusb + btrtl/btmtk/btintel/btbcm (USB B: btusb binds Bluetooth controllers of many vendors (generic class and vendor aliases); its dependency closure declares firmware from firmware-realtek, firmware-mediatek and firmware-iwlwifi, so module -> package is ambiguous at the alias level.
deferred.hci_uart (serial Bluetooth): Only ACPI/OF/tty-ldisc aliases; not representable in inventory v1.
deferred.ath6kl_sdio, rtw88_8723cs, rtw88_8723ds,: SDIO-only aliases; not representable in inventory v1.
deferred.ath11k_pci, ath12k: No declared firmware requests (firmware paths are built at runtime from board data); the module -> firmware-file link cannot be established from package-owned module metadata.
deferred.Realtek audio/card-reader firmware in fi: No PCI/USB network or Bluetooth module requests it; audio and card readers are out of M1-F scope.
deferred.bluez-firmware Raspberry Pi/serial firmw: Only reachable through serial/platform transports; not an amd64 PCI/USB mapping.
